chapters.title: Golden Rule Number 1: Avoid unnecessary details.
Golden Rule Number 2: Do not ask question number two until number one has been answered.
Golden Rule Number 3: Do not interrupt another while he is speaking.
Golden Rule Number 4: Do not contradict another, especially when the subject under discussion is of trivial importance.
Golden Rule Number 5: Do not do all the talking; give your tired listener a chance.
Golden Rule Number 6: Be not continually the hero of your own story; and, on the other hand, do not leave your story without a hero.
Golden Rule Number 7: Choose subjects of mutual interest.
Golden Rule Number 8: Be a good listener.
Golden Rule Number 9: Make your speech in harmony with your surroundings.
Golden Rule Number 10: Do not exaggerate.
Golden Rule Number 11: Indulge occasionally in a relevant quotation, but do not garble it.
